text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-u-t-o-f-f e-l-e-c-t-r-i-c-i-t-y s-e-r-v-i-c-e f-o-r t-h-e t-e-n-a-n-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g e-n-t-r-i-e-s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d o-r-d-e-r f-r-o-m a c-o-u-r-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d l-o-c-k c-y-l-i-n-d-e-r-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t l-a-w-f-u-l e-v-i-c-t-i-o-n, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g k-e-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-n-d i-n-s-t-a-l-l n-o-t-e-s, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l e-v-i-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e s-t-e-p-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-s-s-u-e-d i-n-t-i-m-i-d-a-t-i-n-g c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s t-o t-h-e o-c-c-u-p-a-n-t, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g p-r-i-n-t-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g s a-n-d d-i-g-i-t-a-l c-o-p-i-e-s, i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t u-i-f-t y-r-o-u-g-h s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d m-a-i-n t-e-n-a-n-c-e o-f b-a-s-i-c f-a-c-i-l-i-t-i-e-s t-o r-e-n-d-e-r u-n-i-t u-n-h-a-b-i-t-a-b-l-e, a-c-c-u-m-u-l-a-t-i-n-g f-a-i-l-u-r-e r-e-p-o-r-t-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, w-a-i-v-i-n-g b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g c-o-d-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r h-i-d-e d-e-f-e-c-t-s f-r-o-m i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n p-e-r-s-o-n-n-e-l b-y d-e-l-a-y-i-n-g r-e-p-a-i-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-a-i-n t-e-n-a-n-c-e l-o-g-s i-n-c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e, e-l-u-d-i-n-g r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y o-v-e-r-s-i-g-h-t m-e-c-h-a-n-i-s-m-s.
